finished: THAT IS THE GAME. BACK TO THE CLUB.

steps.say: LEFT STICK: SKATE TO THE PUCK
steps.why: The red ring is you. The arrow is over whoever has the puck.

steps.say: HOLD SHOOT TO WIND UP, LET GO TO FIRE
steps.why: The longer the wind-up, the harder the shot. Point the stick at a corner of the net.

steps.say: TAP PASS: IT GOES TO THE DIAMOND
steps.why: The diamond is under the team-mate your pass would go to.

steps.say: PASS, THEN HOLD SHOOT BEFORE IT ARRIVES
steps.why: A one-timer beats the goalie about three times as often as a shot off the carry.

steps.say: GET IN FRONT OF HIM AND TAP CHECK
steps.why: A poke takes the puck from in front or beside him, inside the circle, never from behind.

steps.say: HOLD CHECK, LET GO AS YOU REACH HIM
steps.why: A body check knocks him off the puck. Come in fast and it puts him on the ice.
